parsed_result.leonSummary: Mapping is real and the scope is tight — ship it, but force it to read the planner's 'candidates' (not the ranker's field-poor 'entries') and make the no-fabrication test prove repo_facts_block and the registry/lineage internals don't leak, not just some made-up key.
mappingCorrections: Candidate JSON keys are snake_case (asdict): finding_id, target_paths, evidence_refs, source_recommended_action, success_criterion, grounding_constraints, verification_commands, priority_score. Top-level plan keys are camelCase ('candidates'). Don't assume camelCase inside a candidate.

'top rank-1 candidate': select the candidate whose rank == 1 explicitly (it is candidates[0] today because planner assigns rank = len(planned)+1 over rank-sorted findings), but assert rank==1 rather than blindly trusting list position — fail closed if no rank==1 exists.

Title fallback is sound: planner sets title = finding.get('title','') which can be ''; fallback to finding_id is grounded, not fabricated. Ensure fallback triggers on empty/whitespace, not just missing key.

evidence_refs is a tuple of dicts (raw scorecard evidence). Render via json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True) so key order in the source plan can't change bytes. 'Why' mixing structured evidence_refs with the source_recommended_action string under one heading is acceptable labeling, not a domain change.
nonGoalsToPolice: Do not read proposal_ranker 'entries' — only proposal_planner 'candidates'.
No re-ranking, re-sorting, or recomputing priority; trust the stored rank/priority_score.
No derived priority labels/buckets from priority_score — render the value as-is.
No network, no LLM, no provider calls — pure deterministic render.
No new fields on ProposalCandidate and no edits to planner/ranker/scorer/verifier/schema/domains.
No narrative prose beyond fixed headings/labels; do not summarize or interpret candidate content.
Do not emit repo_facts_block, registry status, lineage, or any internal provenance field.
scopeRisks: Two artifacts exist: proposal_planner emits proposal-plan/v0 with full 'candidates' (intent, success_criterion, grounding_constraints, verification_commands, evidence_refs, source_recommended_action); proposal_ranker emits ranked-proposals/v0 with 'entries' that LACK every one of those fields except title/finding_id/priority_score. The emit MUST read the planner's 'candidates'. If it accidentally targets ranker output, most headings render empty and the feature is silently broken.

ProposalCandidate also carries large/internal fields not in the mapping (repo_facts_block [bulky text], repo_facts_hash, intent_hash, proposal_key, registry_status, base_lineage, rank, target_path singular). Risk of leaking these into the ticket; repo_facts_block especially would dump a wall of text.

Mapping 'Priority' from priority_score risks derivation creep: rendering the raw float is in-scope, but bucketing into High/Med/Low is fabrication beyond the frozen mapping. Police against any computed label.
No gates/registry/lineage/GitHub/worktree imports — confirmed out of scope and none are needed for a pure field-to-Markdown render.
testCorrections: The no-fabrication test must do MORE than check an invented key is absent: add a candidate fixture populated with sentinel values for the REAL unmapped fields (repo_facts_block, repo_facts_hash, proposal_key, registry_status, intent_hash, base_lineage, target_path-singular, rank) and assert NONE of those sentinels appear in the Markdown. That's the actual leak risk.
'renders rank 1 only' needs a negative assertion: include a rank-2 candidate with a distinctive sentinel and assert that sentinel does NOT appear.

Determinism test should also cover stable evidence_refs rendering: render once, render again from a copy whose evidence_ref dict keys are inserted in a different order, assert byte-identical output (not just two runs of the same object).
Add an explicit empty-omission test: a candidate with empty grounding_constraints (and/or empty verification_commands) must omit that section entirely — no dangling heading, no empty bullet.
Add a fallback-path test: empty title → finding_id appears as the title.
CLI test: assert exit 0, file written, file bytes == render output. Empty-candidates test: assert non-zero/raises AND that no output file is written (fail closed, no partial artifact).
